name.ja: 1/35 MS-06R-1A ザクヘッド（黒い三連星カラーVer.）
name.en: 1/35 MS-06R-1A Zaku Head (Black Tri-Star Color Ver.)

description.ja: 大迫力！１/３５スケールザクヘッドが黒い三連星カラーで登場！
description.en: Very impressive! 1/35 Scale Zaku head now available in black tri-star color!
The approaching black Zaku -------------------

description.ja: １／３５スケール ザクヘッドを黒い三連星カラーで商品化。
description.en: 1/35 Scale Zaku head commercialized in black triple star color.

description.ja: 特徴的な頭部ブレードアンテナを新規造形で再現！
description.en: Reproduce the characteristic head blade antenna with new modeling!

description.ja: 黒い三連星（ガイア／マッシュ／オルテガ）の各機頭部を選択式で再現可能！
description.en: Each machine head of the black triple star (Gaia/Mash/Ortega) can be selectively reproduced!

description.ja: 各機のナンバーが入った水転写デカールおよび１／１４４キット（別売）と一緒に飾れるディスプレイペースが付属！
description.en: Includes a water slide decal with the number of each machine and a display space that can be displayed together with the 1/144 Kit (sold separately)!

description.ja: ● かぎ型形状の頭部アンテナパーツを新規造形で再現。
description.en: ● The hook-shaped head antenna parts are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: かぎ型形状の指揮官機用ブレードアンテナを新規造形で再現。Ｓ型ザクに代表される形状のブレードアンテナも付属。
description.en: The hook-shaped blade antenna for the commander aircraft is reproduced with new modeling. A blade antenna shaped like the S-type Zaku is also included.

description.ja: ● 黒い三連星の各機が、パーツの選択式で再現可能。
description.en: ● Each Black Tri-Star machine can be reproduced by selecting parts.

description.ja: アンテナのない頭部パーツも付属し、ガイア機、マッシュ機、オルテガ機のそれぞれを、選択式で再現可能。
description.en: A head part without an antenna is also included, allowing you to selectively reproduce Gaia's machine, Mash machine, and Ortega's machine.

description.ja: 各機のナンバーが入った水転写デカールが付属。
description.en: A water slide decal with each machine's number is included.

description.ja: モノアイは、クリアピンクの成形色で再現。
description.en: The mono eye is reproduced in clear pink molding color.

description.ja: ※商品内に含まれる頭部は１機分です。
description.en: *The head included in the product is for one machine.

description.ja: （各機の再現はパーツの選択式のため、３機を再現するには、この商品が３個必要です）
description.en: (Since each aircraft is reproduced by selecting parts, you will need 3 of this product to reproduce 3 aircraft)

description.ja: ● ディスプレイベースが付属。
description.en: ● Display base included.

description.ja: 岩をイメージしたディスプレイベース。1/35ザクヘッドをディスプレイできる他、高さが一段低い部分には、
description.en: A display base with the image of a rock. In addition to displaying the 1/35 Zaku head, there is also a section that is one step lower in height.

description.ja: １／１４４スケールＭＳ（別売）等を配置する事が可能。機体名の銘鈑シールが付属。
description.en: It is possible to place 1/144 Scale MS (sold separately), etc. A plaque with the name of the aircraft is included.
